thread:
maria: quick heads-up — regen step fails in ONNX conversion when running the 0.18.0 build pipeline. error: "mismatch tensor dims after reshape". this blocks the semver bump.
ryan: ouch. do we know if it's the converter or a model change? can we patch with a small transform?
aj: looks like the exporter flipped an axis for the lm_head. i'll try a minimal fix + unit test and open a PR. ETA ~2h.
samira: if we slip the release, what's the proposed window? cc @devex for announcement hold.
maria: leaning to slip ~18h so we can do a proper backfill and a changelog review. propose new release: 2026-03-18 09:00 PT (was 2026-03-17 15:00 PT). thoughts?
ryan: ok with +18h if aj can get the PR + tests in. do we need a canary hold? :clock1:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary gating: canary run triggered, status: HOLD — waiting for manual approval (reason: release slip requested).
aj: opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4821 — includes a tiny reshape fix and an added regression test. patch applies cleanly to release branch.
ryan: nice. can you also add a note in the changelog entry under "bugfixes" so release notes don't surprise customers?
aj: will add a 1-liner and link to the test.
samira: i can take changelog + announce copy after aj pushes. devex, can you draft a short notice for #announcements? probably: "small delay to apply ONNX export fix; new ETA 09:00 PT tomorrow."
devex: yup i'll draft and queue it but hold until release manager gives final go. will include impact blurb and the PR link.
maria: release manager ping @ryan — can you set the release flag to HOLD and coordinate the canary re-run after PR merges? also update the release kanban.
ryan: on it. setting flag now: `./scripts/release set-flag --id 0.18.0 --state hold --note "ONNX exporter fix pending"`
ryan: flag set. will re-run canary after merge and smoke tests. anyone foresee downstream incompat issues with minor reshape?
aj: tested basic chat + embeddings flows locally and on staging, looks okay. adding extra smoke step to CI to be safe.
samira: i'll update CHANGELOG.md with the 1-liner and add the PR link. sending draft to #announcements in 30m for review.
maria: thanks all. final ask: if anyone hits a blocker making the PR mergeable (conflicts, lint), ping here asap. otherwise we'll target the new ETA and release notes should reflect the small bugfix and the hold reason.
ryan: ping me if tests flake — i'll re-run. :thumbsup:
devex: draft ready, holding for release-manager approval. preview: "We're delaying today's release by ~18 hours to apply a fix to the ONNX export that could affect tokenization alignment in some edge cases. No user data impact. New ETA: 2026-03-18 09:00 PT."
maria: perfect. approve when PR merged. thanks everyone. :rocket:
